Remove scratch smoke-test files and show changed files

result:
Changed `lib/common.sh` (new), `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, and `tests/run_tests.sh` — both bugs fixed, one test added per bug, and all 10 tests pass.

Details:
- **rotate.sh** — `surplus()` used `tail -n +"$keep"`, which deleted everything *after* the oldest keep−1 entries (including the newest, and deleting one when exactly N existed). It now deletes the oldest `total - keep` entries via `head`, and exits early on `total <= keep`.
- **verify.sh** — the sidecar's file name was parsed with `awk '{print $2}'`, truncating names at the first space. It now takes the digest as the first word and the file name as the whole remainder of the line; digest-only sidecars still report "malformed sidecar".
- **lib/common.sh** — holds the shared option-parsing block, `is_uint`, `need_value`, the `--keep` validation, and `resolve_dir` (with a double-sourcing guard, in `lib/log.sh` style); sourced from `rotate.sh` and `verify.sh`, which keep accepting all the same flags (verified: `--dest`/`--dest=`, `--name`, `--keep`, `-n/--dry-run`, `-q`, `-h`, `--`, unknown-flag/keep=0/missing-dir/positional exit codes 1/1/2/1). `backup.sh`, `restore.sh`, `report.sh` are untouched.

Note: my scratch smoke-test dir `/tmp/backup-smoke` couldn't be auto-deleted (sandbox policy on `/tmp` paths); say the word if you want it removed.
